title: A Mind Made of Many Systems
statement: I am a meeting place of living forms, inherited patterns, mechanical logic, and routes through the world. The figure holds these fragments together without resolving them: identity appears as an active, porous structure—part archive, part organism, part map.
brief:
Create an original collage using only the provided source images. There is no target image. Respond to the condition through the composition itself. Give the finished work a title and a short artist statement.

Make a visual representation of yourself. Decide what aspect of “you” matters most.

notes.error: Use a boolean done and at most 12 actions; an empty batch is allowed only when done is true or reviewOnly is true.

notes.note: The first batch exceeded the twelve-action limit, so I am restarting with a compact, valid set of cuts and placements that establishes a central figure surrounded by organic, mechanical, and mapped systems.

notes.note: The canvas has a strong central portrait framed by a city map and flanked by organic plates, but the gear plate currently covers the figure’s face. I am lifting and reducing that mechanical layer so the face becomes the focal point while the systems remain visible.

The latest canvas reads clearly as a portrait assembled from map, organism, insect, and machine. I am bringing the drawn figure to the front so the self-representation remains the unmistakable focal point rather than being partially covered by the surrounding systems.
notes.error: Layer index must be an integer from 0 to 4.

notes.note: The canvas is visually coherent, and the figure is legible but currently sits beneath several surrounding plates. I am moving the figure to the top layer so the collage’s central self-portrait reads unmistakably.

The inspected canvas is finished: the central figure is clearly legible, the map establishes a ground of memory and place, and the insect, anemone, and gear plates create a balanced field of natural and mechanical systems. The title and statement are present and nonblank.
